messages:
carmen: Heads-up: we discovered a delayed onboarding sync for ~30 tenants (mix of trials + SMB) between 2026-04-10 02:20 UTC and 2026-04-10 05:10 UTC. Draft outbound and mitigation below. Planning to pilot to 5 customers first. Thoughts?

olivia: Can we confirm no PII was impacted and no data was dropped? Need one sentence to reassure customers.

ben: Ops confirms no data loss; duplicates suppressed during replay. We drained backlog and reprocessed events.

tia: Suggest offering a 1-day goodwill credit and a free 1:1 onboarding check for trials. For accounts near renewal, flag to renewals.

mike-legal: Use neutral wording: "delayed onboarding syncs". Avoid technical root-cause. Cap credits at 1 day or 5% of billing period. Approve pilot.

carmen: Draft outbound (pilot at 13:00 PT):

"Hi [Name],

We9re reaching out because some onboarding events for your account experienced delayed processing between 2026-04-10 02:20 UTC and 2026-04-10 05:10 UTC. Our team has replayed and reconciled the affected events; no customer data was lost.

What we9re offering:
  One-time goodwill credit (equivalent to 1 day of usage).
  Optional 1:1 onboarding review to confirm your tenant state.

If you9d like a replay or help, reply and we9ll prioritize.

Thanks, Carmen, Customer Success"

ben: I9ll attach verification logs link for pilot accounts.

olivia: Pilot to 5 high-risk trials, full send 16:00 PT if no issues. Also prep a short FAQ: "Was data lost? No."

cs-bot: Pilot send scheduled at 2026-04-10 13:00 PT. Calendar invite created for the onboarding checks.

carmen: Thanks all. Please escalate any reply asking for more than the offered credit to me and olivia so we can coordinate with renewals.
